title: Ecosystem perspective for effective occupational safety and health interventions: a cross-national expert study
core_idea: Introduce a circular-ecosystem perspective to reconceptualize occupational safety and health (OSH) interventions by focusing on processes, actors, and underlying dynamics across intervention development phases (design, implementation, evaluation, follow-up) and five ecosystem elements (value, actors, data/materials/flows, circular activities/strategies, governance). The study uses a qualitative, exploratory two-phase expert engagement (exploratory interviews followed by a focus group) to shape this perspective.
tldr: Proposes using a circular-ecosystem lens to guide development of OSH interventions, emphasizing multi-actor processes, contextual dynamics, and intervention phases rather than isolated actions.
